dedupe_keys.name: publicly reported state municipal solid waste data for the united states target year 2018 epa ord version 1

description: This dataset compiles the municipal solid waste figures that US states publish about themselves. It was assembled by the US Environmental Protection Agency's Office of Research and Development through a web search of state sources, as part of a study comparing methods for estimating national waste amounts published by Vines, Pasquali, Ganguli and Meyer in the Journal of Cleaner Production in 2023. The compilation covers municipal solid waste generation, recycling and disposal, with 2018 as the target year, and comes as one Excel workbook (Compiled State Public Waste Data) listed on data.gov and hosted on EPA's ScienceHub server, free to download under the ScienceHub licence. Coverage is the states that report such data. Caveats: availability varies greatly because states define and report waste differently, so figures are not directly comparable, and some states report nothing. Simulation uses: state-level waste flows to calibrate or check waste generation and disposal estimates in US waste service models. Related records: EPA's Sustainable Materials Management facts and figures (data-epa-sustainable-materials-management-facts-and-figures) give the national estimates that this compilation was compared with.
